title_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in Don Bosco
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in Don Bosco. The apartment is located on the 6th floor of a new residential building with an elevator near Viva Market, it has a net area of ​​54 m², gross 59 m², it is completely reconstructed, it is laid with parquet, it has a regular mortgage document and it has a favorable orientation to the south-east. The price is 115,000 euros.
